title: Fred Warner: I know Kyle Shanahan's itching to be back, and there's no rush

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fred Warner: I know Kyle Shanahan's itching to be back, and there's no rush
sources.description: While some in the 49ers organization did not know about head coach Kyle Shanahan's accident until the team's announcement over the weekend, others had been informed a while ago.
